age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing

group.Description: Group the participant belonged to (e.g., healthy, patients)

bci_experience.Description: BCI experience level of the participant

study.Description: Study of the release in which the participant was recorded (added in 1.1.0).

Levels.1: first study: unilateral and bilateral conditions, shielded cabin
Levels.2: second study: unilateral condition only, standard laboratory

source_id.Description: Pseudo-code of the participant in the release's folder and file names (added in 1.1.0).
